usd_reason: The dollar had its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: Lower US Treasury yields and de-escalation hopes in Iran could boost gold prices
indices_reason: The market is waiting for more information on interest rates and inflation
lead_story: The US dollar had a bad week due to doubts about the Fed's ability to raise interest rates, oil prices are falling due to hopes of de-escalation in Iran, and the US Treasury yields are also falling, all of which are affecting the market, the Fed is considering raising interest rates to address inflation, and this is the biggest macro driver right now, it will likely impact the economy and the financial markets in the coming weeks
